title: London Movie Hotels You Can Really Book
description: Three real London hotels seen on screen, from the Savoy and Hilton Hyde Park to St Pancras, that you can book today.
h1: 3 London movie hotels you can really book
intro: London's grand hotels have turned up in romances, thrillers and superhero films. These three have a documented place on screen and welcome guests today.

hotels.note: The finale of Notting Hill (1999) takes place at a press conference in the hotel's Lancaster Room.
As the Coburg Hotel, it appears in Hitchcock's Frenzy (1972), where Blaney and Babs check in as Mr. and Mrs. Oscar Wilde.
Its staircase doubled for the Arkham Asylum stairwell in Batman Begins (2005).

outro: The Savoy is on the Strand near Covent Garden, the Hilton overlooks Hyde Park, and St Pancras sits beside the Eurostar terminal. Choose the base that suits your plans.
